---
title: '20260520'
version: 0.53.0
date: 2026-05-20
description: Added Codex Plan Mode support, improved streaming Markdown performance, and fixed mobile sign-in, onboarding, GitHub identity, PR refresh, and local-project branch loading issues.
---
### New

- Added support for the Codex Plan Mode flow.

### Fixes and Improvements

- Improved streaming Markdown rendering performance in conversations.
- Fixed a blank screen after the first successful sign-in in the native mobile app.
- The onboarding flow can now skip Agent connection and let you configure it later from Settings.
- Fixed failures when refreshing Claude configuration.
- Fixed abnormal font rendering on Android.
- Fixed cases where actions still used the wrong identity after personal GitHub permissions had been granted.
- Fixed stale PR pages not refreshing automatically.
- Raised the threshold before long pasted text is collapsed into a compact preview.
- Fixed timeouts while loading branch information for local projects, and added a manual refresh entry.
